_note: Choices made by a model handed, for each request, the candidates shown in `candidates` (each in full: name, category, summary, distinguishes), in that order, with the prompt in `choice_at_scale.PROMPT`. Twelve choosers, one per set size and quarter of the requests, so no chooser saw a request twice. Sets start from what the fullest declaration delivers and are filled to 30, 40 and 50 with the operations the lexical ranker scores closest to the request. Scored by `python benchmarks/choice_at_scale.py score` against tests/data/discovery_queries.json.
harness: Claude Code subagents, one pack file each, told to read nothing else
